name: @rustybuns/rig
description: auto-rig's voxel rigger (skeleton and skin weights from any mesh), its wire codec, the GLB bake that feeds it, and the closed-chain IK that poses the result, plus a real hand (skeleton, skin, grip solver, mesh) that Sound Guy Simulator and Qollab Studio wear. auto-rig and Mythic Masters share the rigger; the Rust twin stays in apps/auto-rig/native.
